description: This file contains unit tests for the quiche QUIC protocol simulator, including tests for counters, packet handling, link saturation, queues, network switching, alarms, packet filtering, traffic policing, and packet aggregation.

classes.name: Counter
classes.description: A simple actor that increments its value periodically.

classes.name: SimulatorTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for simulator tests.

classes.name: CounterPort
classes.description: A port that counts received packets and bytes, and per-destination packets.

classes.name: LinkSaturator
classes.description: Simulates a link that transmits packets at a specified rate to a destination.

classes.name: PacketAcceptor
classes.description: A port that accepts and stores incoming packets.

classes.name: AlarmToggler
classes.description: An actor that toggles a QuicAlarm on and off at specified intervals.

classes.name: CounterDelegate
classes.description: A delegate that counts how many times an alarm fires.

classes.name: MockPacketFilter
classes.description: A mock class for packet filtering, used in tests.

methods.name: get_value
methods.description: Returns the current value of the counter.

methods.name: Act
methods.description: Performs the actor's action, e.g., incrementing counters or toggling alarms.

methods.name: AcceptPacket
methods.description: Accepts a packet and updates counters accordingly.

methods.name: times_set
methods.description: Returns how many times the alarm was set.

methods.name: times_cancelled
methods.description: Returns how many times the alarm was cancelled.
